name: broken tackles from plays for wide receivers via trg_pid
description: Strict trg_pid attribution check: filtered to WR-only with a minimum games threshold, this view exercises the receiving-only side of the COALESCE(bc_pid, trg_pid) attribution. Pre-fix (pid_columns: ['bc_pid']), every row would render as zero broken tackles because nfl_plays.bc_pid is NULL on completed receptions -- WR broken tackles are attributed to trg_pid. Post-fix the column must surface non-zero totals for players like Puka Nacua and Zay Flowers.
expected_query: with "t0635926aa2abe4b5124b13d9f5818810" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid, target_pid) as pid, SUM(mbt) as broken_tackles_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2025) group by COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid, target_pid)), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "t0a1286e29a881dbb25dbfc5a1b73d78a" as materialized (select COALESCE(target_pid) as pid, SUM(CASE WHEN target_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as trg_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2025) group by COALESCE(target_pid)) select "player"."pid", "t0635926aa2abe4b5124b13d9f5818810"."broken_tackles_from_plays" AS "broken_tackles_from_plays_0", "t0a1286e29a881dbb25dbfc5a1b73d78a"."trg_from_plays" AS "trg_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t0635926aa2abe4b5124b13d9f5818810" on "t0635926aa2abe4b5124b13d9f5818810"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t0a1286e29a881dbb25dbfc5a1b73d78a" on "t0a1286e29a881dbb25dbfc5a1b73d78a"."pid" = "player"."pid" where player.primary_position IN ('WR') group by "t0635926aa2abe4b5124b13d9f5818810"."broken_tackles_from_plays", "t0a1286e29a881dbb25dbfc5a1b73d78a"."trg_from_plays", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 2 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 15
